title: melia azedarach var. toosendan
intro: Melia azedarach var. toosendan, commonly known as Chinese Toon, is a deciduous tree native to Asia, belonging to the family Meliaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. Additionally, the plant's extracts have shown potential in treating various diseases, including cancer, due to their cytotoxic and antiproliferative properties.
